senses.gloss: 1. अत् ind. a prefix said to imply ‘surprise’, probably a contraction of अति, meaning ‘extraordinary’, (g. ऊर्य्-आदि, q.v.)
आ॑त् ind. (abl. of 4. अ) afterwards, then (often used in a concluding paragraph antithetically to य॑द्, यदा, य॑दि. and sometimes strengthened by the particles अ॑ह, इ॑द्, ईम्, उ), RV.; AV.
then, further, also, and, RV.; AV. It is sometimes used after an interrogative pronoun (like उ, नु॑, अङ्ग॑) to give emphasis to the pronoun, RV.
